# Mobile Onboarding Screen

## Context
- Product: Habit tracking app for busy professionals
- Audience: First-time mobile users, ages 25–45
- Stage: Refinement
- Focus: Mobile onboarding clarity and CTA prominence

## Screen Description
A single mobile screen with a white background and a top illustration of a person checking items off a checklist. Below it is the headline "Build better routines" in large bold text, then supporting text: "Track habits, stay consistent, and see your progress over time."

Under the copy are three selectable goal chips in one row: "Sleep better", "Exercise", and "Read more". The first chip is filled blue with white text; the others are outlined gray.

Below that is a primary button labeled "Continue" in solid blue. Under the button is a low-contrast text link saying "Skip for now".

At the very top is a small progress indicator showing "Step 1 of 4" centered. There is no back button. The screen uses a mix of 16px and 18px body text, and the spacing between the headline and supporting text is tight compared with the generous spacing elsewhere.

The illustration is visually dominant and takes about 35% of the screen height.

## Requested Deliverable
Provide a structured design critique using the skill's output format.
